title: The four-state momentum cycle (Goulding-Harvey-Mazzoleni) as a long/flat timing rule vs the jump-model trend switch
states: daily classification from paris.momentum_states: SLOW = trailing 252-day arithmetic mean return, FAST = 21-day; Bull (+,+), Bear (-,-), Correction (+,-), Rebound (-,+); state at close T-1 sets exposure for day T
long_only_mapping: the paper's position w in [-1,1] is mapped to exposure e = (w+1)/2 in [0,1]: Bull 1, Bear 0, Correction 1-a_Co, Rebound a_Re

arms.DYN (primary): Proposition 9 dynamic speeds a_Co, a_Re estimated by paris.dynamic_speeds on the expanding history up to each year-end (first estimate after 5 years of states), applied through the following year; NaN speeds fall back to 0.5
arms.MED (static): equation 11 with a = 0.5 for both Correction and Rebound (exposure 0.5 in both)
arms.Bull+Rebound: long only when FAST >= 0 (Bull, Rebound); flat in Correction and Bear
arms.OutOnlyBear: long in Bull, Correction, Rebound; flat only in Bear
arms.SlowSign: long when SLOW >= 0 (Bull, Correction) — the pure 12-month rule trend λ5 was calibrated against

execution: as frozen_rule_benchmark: 10 bp one-way, T-bill cash, exposure for T from close T-1; OOS from the first date every arm is valid (trend warm-up 1,260 + DYN 5-year speed warm-up)
metrics_primary: Martin (paired vs trend λ5, 1,000-draw bootstrap CI)

decision_rule.PROMOTE_over_trend: median ΔMartin vs trend λ5 > 0 with CI excluding 0, OR wins >= 6/8 with median ΔSharpe >= 0; AND bleed not worse than trend by > 0.10 in any bull fold
decision_rule.also_reported: each arm vs Buy & hold; per-fund four-state conditional tables (paris.momentum_state_table) to show information content beside rule performance

prior: DYN and MED: about 1 in 4 to beat trend λ5 on Martin (they flip with the raw signs; the jump penalty was introduced precisely to suppress that); discrete arms: below 1 in 5
